name: Oukyuu no Shugosha-tachi
source:
You lived an ordinary life. One day, a black hole suddenly sunders the sky open and was followed by mass earthquakes that drove the Earth to ruin. The gods from Egyptian mythology appear in front of you just as you are cornered by mysterious monsters.

The gods tell you that you must stop the King of the Underworld, Anubis, if you want to save the world.

Which god will you choose to help you defeat Anubis?

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.egyptkaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你过着平凡的生活。有一天，一个黑洞突然将天空撕裂，随后发生了大规模地震，将地球推向毁灭。当你被神秘怪物围困时，埃及神话中的众神出现在你面前。

众神告诉你，如果你想拯救世界，就必须阻止地狱之王阿努比斯。

你会选择哪位神来帮助你击败阿努比斯？

[来源：[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.egyptkaigai&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
